info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Project Finance Management API
info.description: The Project Finance Management API enables users to access and retrieve detailed financial information related to trade banking projects. It serves financial institutions, project managers, and stakeholders involved in large-scale projects by providing insights into funding status, investment returns, and associated risks. This API supports seamless data integration for performance monitoring and financial reporting, enhancing decision-making processes. Utilize this API to stay informed about the financial health of ongoing projects and to analyze historical data for future investments.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access detailed information about project finance opportunities and related data in trade banking. Use this to get insights into ongoing projects and financial arrangements.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a project finance operation within the trade banking system. It contains all necessary parameters and configurations needed for retrieving project finance-related information.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning project finance details.
